summary: Interpreted the notify-commit probe. Receipt a279385b64864dba947ce11fe8170bcc passed with four events: the fresh proposal delivered RequestCommitted then RequestCompleted, while the proposal whose deadline passed before application delivered RequestTimeout and nothing on the commit channel. Recorded an experiment-level interpretation with conclusion holds and defect_claim refuted, cited the contract and shard-apply sources, marked the investigation explained, and promoted the two-phase behavior to knowledge with the receipt indices. Limits noted: object-level probe only, single read of the commit channel, one schedule.
